description: Validate a website's robots.txt and XML sitemaps: robots.txt syntax, which AI crawlers it allows or blocks, the Sitemap directive, sitemap XML validity, URL counts against the protocol limits, child sitemaps of a sitemap index, and lastmod coverage. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

title: Check robots.txt and sitemap
